analysis.title: MasTec Inc. (MTZ): Announces Agreement to Acquire Murphy Corporation; Strengthens Prefabrication and Exposure to High-Growth End-Markets
key_insights: MasTec announced before the open on 11/20/2026 that it will acquire Murphy Corporation, a mechanical contractor with engineering, preconstruction and prefabrication expertise, for about $1.25B in cash. A potential earnout is tied to Murphy's cumulative 3-year financial performance after closing.
The deal is financed with a bank term loan and is expected to close expeditiously.

MTZ says the deal strengthens its prefabrication and construction expertise and adds exposure to data centers, healthcare, aviation & defense and pharmaceutical manufacturing. Murphy also provides recurring maintenance services.

Per the release, Murphy is expected to generate about $775M of revenue and about $140M of adjusted EBITDA in 2026. That implies an acquisition price of roughly 8.9x 2026 adjusted EBITDA (computed from the figures above, not stated in the report).
MTZ expects the deal to be accretive to revenue, adjusted EBITDA, EPS and cash flow from operations immediately after closing.
Murphy delivered double-digit revenue and EBITDA growth for the two years ended March 31, 2026. MTZ expects continued growth from recurring services and its position in high-growth end-markets.
Pro forma net leverage after closing will be about 2.7x. MTZ expects to bring it below 2.0x in 2027.
GS keeps its Buy rating and 12-month price target of $274, based on a 12.0x NTM EV/EBITDA multiple. The stock closed at $164.76 on 19 Nov 2026, which implies 66.3% upside.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps its Buy rating and $274 target after the Murphy acquisition announcement, based on a 12.0x NTM EV/EBITDA multiple. The report cites 66.3% upside from $164.76.

earnings_insights: Murphy Corporation is expected to generate about $775M of revenue and about $140M of adjusted EBITDA in 2026, per the MTZ release (company expectation, not a reported result).
MTZ expects the deal to be accretive to revenue, adjusted EBITDA, EPS and cash flow from operations immediately after closing (company guidance).
GS estimates for MTZ: 2026E EPS $9.33 (2025 actual $6.55), 2027E $10.28, 2028E $11.56. GS 2026E revenue is $18,186.4M and EBITDA is $1,625.7M.
GS quarterly EPS estimates: 9/26E $3.03, 12/26E $2.69, 3/27E $1.61. The 6/26 figure is $2.22.
risk_factors: A persistent decline in renewable energy-related backlog.
The deal adds leverage, with pro forma net leverage of about 2.7x at close. The deleveraging target of below 2.0x in 2027 is a company expectation.
